title: Finish the /todo cleanup (reject 15 superseded Asks + 24 off-path proposals)
problem: After the 2026-10-10 cleanup, /todo still lists items you would dismiss. 15 Arcadia Agent Asks are superseded: 11 are first drafts whose later revision filed the Decision (their 2026-10-10 rejection failed only on the #1236 prefix bug, fixed in PR #1241), 2 are the /clock request and Plan already delivered by PR #1234, and 2 are the Action-cost research request and its r1 Plan, both superseded by PR #1233 and its r2 proposal. 24 WayProposal review items are off the trial path: 23 of them you rejected on 2026-10-10, and docs sync reopened them at 06:28Z (fixed in PR #1241); one (Field Notes, R378) is tracked by Issue #1211 with its revival trigger. List: docs/reports/todo-bulk-disposition-2026-10-11.json, sha256 fb3675c8b11fd4aac09353c4ee6a73a06660d1cf8994f8e5ed54f9bbc1a8502d; evidence per item in docs/reports/todo-bulk-disposition-2026-10-11.md. Pressing this button is your acceptance of that list; agents cannot reject Asks or review items themselves.
desired_effect: Rejects the 15 pinned pending Arcadia Agent Asks (one recorded settlement each, request id bulk-20261011-<proposal>; the proposal and its content stay in the workspace) and rejects the 24 listed review items (proposal files and Issues stay). Every item is re-checked just before it is applied; anything already settled, decided or changed is skipped and listed. No Project, Plan, Action, pointer, queue or Decision changes. If a rejection archives a drafted Ask file, that commit lands on a fresh worktree branch, operator/todo-bulk-disposition-archives-20261011, which is pushed and opened as a pull request; nothing is committed on the main checkout. Kept visible on purpose: the one-click Launch Ask (critical path), the r2 economic-evidence Plan, the plan-scoped Ask and Ask-capture ideas, the Issue-triage Plan, R380 (supervisors), and R147 and the Living Songbook item (rejecting them would reset or reopen work). Preview read-only first: /Users/pmark/Dev/MR/Arcadia/arcadia/artifacts/generated/operator-scripts/apply-todo-bulk-disposition-20261011.sh --dry-run
preconditions: This script, its descriptor, the list, scripts/apply-todo-bulk-disposition.ts, its src modules, the canonical writers and src/docs/sync.ts are tracked, unmodified, and identical to origin/main in the Arcadia checkout (so PR #1241's fixes are in place)
The list's sha256 is fb3675c8b11fd4aac09353c4ee6a73a06660d1cf8994f8e5ed54f9bbc1a8502d and every declared proposal is one the list rejects
ARCADIA_WORKSPACE is not exported and the CLI default workspace is martianrover
~/tmp/arcadia-todo-bulk-disposition-20261011 is absent, or is a clean worktree of this repository on operator/todo-bulk-disposition-archives-20261011 (a resumed run)
expected_duration: About 5 to 10 minutes: each of the 15 Asks is previewed and then applied (about 5 seconds each), then 24 review items, and one push and pull request when Ask files were archived. Bounded at 2 hours.
cost_note: No model use and no spend; local Arcadia writes, and at most one push and one pull request.

does: Refuses before any write unless this action's files are tracked, unmodified and identical to origin/main, the list's sha256 matches, the descriptor's declared proposals are all rejections the list makes, ARCADIA_WORKSPACE is not exported and the default workspace is martianrover

Runs under its own operator execution context, so Arcadia's settlement guard admits only disposition rejected and only for the 15 proposals pinned in agentAskRejections; any other settlement is refused by the canonical code, not by this script

For each pinned Agent Ask still pending: previews the canonical settlement (arcadia agent-ask settle, disposition rejected, request id bulk-20261011-<proposal>) and applies exactly that preview fingerprint; skips and records an Ask already settled or missing; any other preview refusal, apply error or settlement needing recovery fails the run so a Retry resumes it
For each listed review item still open or deferred: arcadia review reject <id>; skips and records anything already decided

Runs every settlement from a fresh worktree ~/tmp/arcadia-todo-bulk-disposition-20261011 (branch operator/todo-bulk-disposition-archives-20261011 from origin/main), so any Ask-file archive commit lands there; verifies each such commit is that worktree's HEAD and that the main checkout's HEAD never moves; pushes the branch without force and opens (or reuses) one pull request; removes the worktree and branch when nothing needed archiving
Resumes idempotently: a rerun re-checks every item and skips what is already applied, reuses the same settlement request ids and the existing archive worktree
--dry-run reads the live state, previews every settlement (no apply) and lists exactly what would happen, writing nothing to the workspace, any branch or GitHub
Writes runs/<timestamp-pid>/receipt.json, the per-item disposition-receipt.json and run.log, plus failure-handoff.md on failure
never_does: Never touches cross-repo items (Private Practice Now, Mission Control Site, Rebuster) and never commits on another repository's checkout

Never touches review items R366 (review_c1cc2f67b165454dab) or R368 (review_af4fe69f0faf47ad9b), PR #1212, PR #1033, the Ask pr-opened-arcadia-pr1212, the Ask pr-opened-arcadia-pr1033, PR #1178 or Issue #1177
Never accepts an Ask, settles one outside the pinned 15, or rejects an item whose state changed since the list; never approves or defers a review item

Never touches review items R147 (review_ac701e4ed8a5442099), R380 (review_ed15b634cdcc444084) or the Living Songbook item (review_41438cecfd7743499e), whose rejection would reset or reopen work or answer a live question
Never changes any Project, Plan, Action, pointer, queue or Decision; never completes or reopens a Project
Never commits on the main checkout, force-pushes, rewrites history, merges a pull request or deletes anything other than its own empty archive worktree and branch
Never touches production, the go-broker, a Grant, a Session or any reset, G6, G7 or G8 receipt, and never restarts a service
Never edits the workspace database directly and never exports ARCADIA_WORKSPACE

success.effect: Every pinned item is either rejected or skipped with a recorded reason; the per-item receipt lists each one. /todo no longer shows the superseded Asks or the off-path proposals. If any Ask file was archived, the receipt names the pull request carrying those archive commits.
success.next: Open /todo to confirm the cleanup. If the receipt names an archive pull request, it merges on the normal review gate. Cross-repo items need their own disposition in their repositories.

failure.effect: The receipt and failure handoff name the stage and reason; the per-item receipt lists everything applied before it stopped. Nothing was forced, reset or deleted, no Ask was accepted, and production, the broker and Grants were not touched.
failure.next: Correct the named cause and press Retry; the rerun skips everything already applied and resumes under the same request ids and archive worktree.
